# WattSutra AI

> Offline, deterministic performance-evidence CLI plus 20 portable agent skills (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot). Benchmarks a fixed workload, verifies result quality, compares baseline and candidate with fairness gates and a bootstrap interval, and writes JSON, Markdown and HTML reports. It never presents CPU or wall time as electrical energy, watts, kWh, CO2e or cost; those stay unmeasured unless a real meter reading is imported or the user supplies explicit model inputs. Zero runtime dependencies, Apache-2.0, created by Vatsal Shah.

It is a measurement-honesty tool, not an energy meter. No hardware sensor is read in 0.2. Carbon and cost are modeled only from user-supplied inputs. Hashes detect edits, not forgery.

## Quick start
- `npx wattsutra audit --out report`
- Output: report/audit.json, report/audit.md, report/audit.html
- Requires Node.js 22 or newer.
